positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Design and implement REST APIs using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and JavaScript.  REST APIs deploy as microservice using Docker containers and Azure Kubernetes Service
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · React.js · Express.js · Node.js · MongoDB

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer Boot Camp
positions.description:
Design, develop, and deploy full stack web applications using latest technologies.
Built several Web Apps using full stack methods such as MERN (Mongo DB, Express, React, Node.js). 
Technologies include:
•	Node.js and Express
•	React
•	MongoDB Atlas for No-SQL and JAWSDB for My-SQL databases
•	REST based API, GraphQL and Apollo server/client
•	Javascript, Html, and CSS including CSS framework such as BootStrap
•	Implemented third party APIs such as Google Map Service, Weather Service, and Restaurant Service
•	Using GitHub for source control and Dev-Ops
•	Using Heroku and GitHub for automatic deployment of apps on Heroku
Example of Apps developed and deployed on Heroku:
•	https://project-ems.herokuapp.com/ 
•	https://dkn-ems.herokuapp.com/ 
•	https://dkn-findmyplate.herokuapp.com/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented the REST API using C# and deployed as Azure Service Fabric cloud solutions. The REST API supports the validation of content for authoring and publishing system that deliver help content to Support.Office.com.

Designed and implemented a UI React component and JavaScript for uploading and editing images in the authoring solution for help content that deliver to Support.Office.com.

Designed and implemented a content publishing solution using Azure App Services, Azure Web Jobs, SQL triggers, XML, XSLT, PowerShell, and TSQL.

positions.title: Senior Content Engineer
positions.description:
Designed a multi-tier application for a Video Publishing System using C#, SQL, and ASP.NET that is being used by more than 30 teams at Microsoft including Windows and Office.

Managed the Video Publishing System development project from start to finish.

Implemented a SQL replication solution as part of the Content Management System using SQL transactional replication.

Developed a content authoring solution based on SharePoint web parts.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer II
positions.description:
Designed and developed SQL database solutions for storing and updating data for authoring and publishing of help content in the Exchange product group.

Designed and implemented a solution for building help content for the Exchange Server group using C#, PowerShell, and SQL database.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Test II
positions.description: Developed test automation .NET Enterprise Servers group using C# and Windows Test Technology framework.

positions.title: Senior Server Administrator
positions.description:
Managed servers for .NET Enterprise Servers group.

Managed Application Server for team website.
Backup and restore SQL databases.

positions.title: Senior Support Engineer
positions.description: Tier-3 desktop application, operating system, and networking support for the Windows Server and Network Operation groups at Microsoft.

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description: Developed and improved manufacturing processes for door frames and stringers for 737, 757, and 777 airplanes at the Boeing Sheet Metal Center.
